data.name: Guendolen
data.gender_notes: Guendolen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Gundolinda, Guendolen is a name meaning 'bright warrior' or 'fair warrior'. In legend, Guendolen was the name of a noblewoman who married the hero Roland in the epic poem 'The Song of Roland'. The name Guendolen carries the meaning “Fair, bright warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Guendolen usually hope their child will grow to embody fair, bright warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bearing the light of truth and courage in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Guendolen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fair, bright warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Guendolen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
